easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger from step 3, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
